card.name: Digits inside decimal numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit (or a unit just after one) in the middle of a multi-digit number, usually a decimal in lab values, confidence intervals or dose tables. It fires on the digit partway through the number, before the number is finished.

modes.label: Digit in a confidence interval
modes.description: A digit inside the upper bound of a ratio's confidence interval.

modes.label: Digit in lab or table values
modes.description: A digit within a decimal value in a lab result or a table of measurements.

modes.label: Digit in a concentration or quantity
modes.description: A digit within a measured amount such as ng/mL or million gallons.

card.plain: It marks a digit in the middle of a number, such as a lab value, dose or confidence interval.
